title: Perks menu
summary: Press P (or use the button on the pause menu) to open your perks as a sky of stars. Unlock perks with Advancement Points and activate them with Cosmic Apples, all from the bar along the bottom.
highlights: Hover or click a star to see what it does, its points and its key stats
Right-click a star to unlock it, double-click to add a point
Show, hide and pick classes from the list on the right
